## 3. Simulated analyst triage (proxy, not a human study)

Pooled over seeds: 5000 alerts, of which 189 were false alarms (benign flow flagged). AUROC for telling true attacks from false alarms among raised alerts (95% bootstrap CI):

| Signal available to the analyst | AUROC |
|---|---|
| Model confidence only (all a black box offers) | 0.927 [0.912, 0.941] |
| SHAP-vs-expected-signature agreement | 0.296 [0.256, 0.332] |
| Both (mean of percentile ranks) | 0.682 [0.650, 0.711] |
| *Exploratory, added after the signature signal showed no benefit:* share of |SHAP| mass supporting the verdict | 0.575 [0.529, 0.626] |
| *Exploratory:* confidence + that share | 0.788 [0.763, 0.819] |

Gating policy (deprioritise alerts whose top SHAP features match none/too few of the expected signature features):

| Gate | Alerts kept | False alarms removed | True attacks lost | Precision before → after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S >= 0.33 | 97.2% | 3.7% | 2.7% | 0.962 → 0.963 |
| S >= 0.67 | 51.7% | 19.0% | 49.5% | 0.962 → 0.941 |

For reference, confidence-only AUROC over *all* alerts: GB 0.933 ± 0.013, MLP 0.934 ± 0.002.

## 4. Shortcut-learning audit (seed 0)

| Macro F1 | Explainable GB | Black-box MLP |
|---|---|---|
| Trained without artifact | 0.913 | 0.900 |
| Trained with artifact, same-artifact test | 0.974 | 0.971 |
| Trained with artifact, artifact decorrelated at test | 0.693 | 0.672 |

SHAP global importance of the leaky GB ranks `capture_session` **#3** (14.1% of attribution mass). Top 5: {'flow_iat_std': 0.17436732090532103, 'dst_port': 0.15041042267654, 'capture_session': 0.14069047367521062, 'fwd_pkt_len_mean': 0.06950479646569897, 'syn_flag_count': 0.062297715910086864}.

The MLP's only recourse is post-hoc permutation importance, which ranks the artifact **#1** (top 5 macro-F1 drops: {'capture_session': 0.34531149677069406, 'dst_port': 0.26331482529961153, 'idle_mean': 0.10326309881283413, 'flow_iat_std': 0.07164224043371381, 'syn_flag_count': 0.06670262480826644}). So a global leak can also be found on a black box with extra tooling; what SHAP adds is the same view per alert, exact additivity, and no extra scoring passes.
